camera.proof: Candidates are sorted by nonnegative preference < pi+.1; any blocked ray adds >=100. The first clear candidate is the global minimum. Without a clear candidate all 48 are evaluated.
camera.visibility: Actual street world matrices and visible ancestors; no scenery hidden.
camera.nativeOrbit: Locked R07 has enableDamping=false. Current elevations .19/.34 and distances are inside Workbench min/max bounds, so orbit.update does not clamp these candidates.
camera.scope: Six standing probes at checked locations; cached report is not a new visibility proof after every sub-.65m movement, arbitrary user orbit, or character articulation.

phases.approach: Raise complete hand outside; move above board; lower to actual loaf contact.
phases.held: Lift before .69; move outside through .84; lower to the measured bag thereafter. Cubic clamping keeps the phase endpoints continuous.
phases.origin: Source target is refreshed before grasp, then full palm/object offsets are frozen at actual grasp.

newRollScope.currentHorizontalRadiusInvariant: Yaw only; a newly added roll is not covered by that claim alone.
newRollScope.recommendedExplicitEnvelope: If claiming arbitrary yaw/roll clearance, record full 3D palm-to-eight-corner radius and full 3D native hand radius, or explicitly preserve the yaw-only scope before exiting.

existingDTrace.reason: The existing trace ends in a native pose rejection; it is not a successful buy receipt. The held-only wrist summary excludes a frame released by the failure.

bread.scope: Geometry and phase contract read only, not force/contact/food transaction certification. Native reach limits, actual Cannon response and receipts remain authoritative.
